Noam Rosenthal zcorpan: https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13228 formalizes HTML parser "popping" as "finish parsing the children" (per WebKit terminology). I was thinking of naming it after end tags, but it also happens in a bunch of non-end-tag cases which made me less convinced of that. There's also some differences between Gecko and WebKit (and Chromium) and maybe some cases where no engine currently invokes it but an exposed primitive maybe should.
